hero_text: Personalised tees, sweatshirts, kids' clothes and Cricut gifts for birthdays, hen dos, schools and teams. No order is too small.
hero_quote: Personalised clothing and gifts for every occasion
intro_heading: From your idea to something you can wear
intro_text: I'm the maker behind Your Business Name. Every piece is designed, cut and pressed by hand in my little studio. Send me your idea, a photo or just a name, and I'll turn it into something you'll love to wear or give.

process_steps.title: Pick a design or share your idea
process_steps.text: Choose something from our collections, or tell us what you have in mind.

process_steps.title: Message us on Instagram
process_steps.text: DM us the item, sizes and date. We'll send a mock-up and price before we make anything.

process_steps.title: Collect or post
process_steps.text: Once you're happy, we make it and you collect it or we post it to you.

group_text: Hen parties, sports teams, school leavers and staff uniforms. We love a group order and can match designs with names on the back.
contact_text: The easiest way to order is a quick message on Instagram. Tell us what you'd like and we'll take it from there.
custom_text: Got an idea, a photo or a name you want on something? We do one-offs and group orders.
